blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has not received any document showing that Vice President Sara Duterte transferred ownership of businesses linked to her to other people, an official told the Senate impeachment court on Monday. On the 27th day of Duterte’s impeachment trial, the prosecution team presented SEC Company Registration and Monitoring Department Director Gerardo del Rosario to testify on the alleged interests of Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, in 18 companies. Del Rosario confirmed that the vice president was listed as one of the incorporators of Metro City Chow Foods Corp. in 2016 and […]...
